svg.title: Flight 9 reprocessed: hazards in red and landing candidates in green
svg.desc: Six original NASA/JPL frames with unchanged red, green and cyan overlays. NASA/JPL defines the colours. The red numbers and cyan markers are not explained in the public description of PIA25662.
